as described in https://github.com/ethereum/eth1.0-specs/blob/master/json-rpc/spec.json#L1595 london doesn’t kick in until block 500, pre london blocks must omit baseFeePerGas please let me know if you have a recommendation on better encoding this in the openrpc spec How about `Before London, this field must empty.` -> `This field should only be included after the London fork is activated, and must be omitted on non-London networks or in pre-London blocks.` Though if you meant how to encode that in the schema vs. the wording I've no idea how/if we could do that with OpenRPC. oooh, we could add a "Specification Extension" like `"x-required-fork": "London"`: https://spec.open-rpc.org/#specification-extensions <@!543900561460822016> ah thanks - I assumed the 1559 testnet has 1559 activated since genesis - bad assumption - this explains it - thanks!
